mapper.select: select id, request_no, ticket_id, verifier_id, verifier_name_snapshot, result, failure_reason, device_no, verified_at from verification_record where request_no = #{requestNo}
select id, request_no, ticket_id, verifier_id, verifier_name_snapshot, result, failure_reason, device_no, verified_at from verification_record where request_no = #{requestNo} for update
mapper.insert: insert into verification_record (request_no, ticket_id, verifier_id, verifier_name_snapshot, result, failure_reason, device_no, verified_at) values (#{requestNo}, #{ticketId}, #{verifierId}, #{verifierNameSnapshot}, #{result}, #{failureReason}, #{deviceNo}, #{verifiedAt})
